question: Devouring Hellion makes me sacrifice permanents as it enters. If a sacrificed permanent, like Kronch Wrangler, has an ability that triggers when Devouring Hellion enters, does it trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: No: those abilities won't trigger, because the permanents are sacrificed before Devouring Hellion has entered.
expected.answer: If any of the sacrificed permanents have abilities that trigger when Devouring Hellion enters the battlefield (such as that of Kronch Wrangler), those abilities won’t trigger.
